entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Fifteen New Zealand restaurants now hold a coveted Michelin star after undercover inspectors secretly visited restaurants here for almost a year | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Chef Paul Froggatt is the director of culinary at Roki Connection, which runs Essence in Queenstown. The restaurant was the only one in New Zealand to receive the two-star accolade at Oceania's first Michelin Guide awards on Tuesday night.
 
110 eateries made it into the guide, with Michelin saying it's rare to award so many stars in a country's inaugural launch.

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/life/food/every-new-zealand-restaurant-in-the-michelin-guide-and-the-ones-that-stood-out
